contract_clause: Harden 21 weak fuzz functions — error exhaustiveness
domain_claim: Every error match arm in a fuzz harness must explicitly list all currently-defined error variants of the production crate. Adding a new variant to the production error enum must not silently succeed in existing fuzz harnesses.
model_boundary: Production crate error enums ↔ fuzz/src/lib.rs match arms
notes: Requires a CI check that compares fuzz harness error match arms against production enum definitions. Without this, error exhaustiveness rots silently.

contract_clause: Harden 21 weak fuzz functions — roundtrip determinism

notes: Affects journal_event (already has roundtrip), ipc_frame (header roundtrip exists), and slot_value_roundtrip. decode_record target needs roundtrip assertions added.

contract_clause: Harden 21 weak fuzz functions — admission boundary
